description: Start an explicitly requested VA connection for this signed-in account and assistant. Requires owner:va permission. Show connection_url to confirm the account and selected fields, review an existing saved verification or complete a new official VA sign-in, and approve this app's sharing separately. Verification is saved to the account only after approval. Return to this conversation and call get_va_connection afterward. The link itself grants no access; never request passwords, tokens, SSNs or full VA documents in chat.
name: start_va_connection
